entries.label: Pakistan — hangar de la base aérienne avant EXCELSUS
entries.scene: The interior AIRCRAFT HANGAR of the Pakistani airbase during MGR R-07 BEFORE the EXCELSUS battle. Closely use the visible architecture in the reference screenshots: very high pitched roof carried by repeated grey steel triangular trusses, long banks of large rectangular blue-grey high windows below the roof, broad dark concrete floor, elevated metal service catwalks and simple railings along the rear side, stacks of dark green rectangular cargo containers at the perimeter. Cold subdued industrial night lighting. Make an EMPTY architectural stage plate with aircraft, robots and people omitted so those remain independent assets; preserve the parking space and the large hangar proportions. No collapsed stadium, desert arena, invented launch platform, flags or science-fiction reactor.
